set.note: Primarily human-driven development with AI-assisted tools: a person designed and directed the work and tested, reviewed and revised all of it, with AI coding tools helping to write the code and the text.
The mod is a window onto Force, a program you install on your computer yourself. It talks only to that Force: nothing is sent anywhere else.
interactions: Starts Force's frontend API (force api, through wsl.exe on Windows) on your computer and talks to it over its standard input and output
Opens a web link in your browser when you Ctrl+click it (Cmd+click on macOS)

set.note: It shows the coding agents (such as Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode) that you run in Force, and lets you answer them. The mod runs no AI model itself.
